stories.title: Define enrollment status scoring schema and contract
stories.description: Create normalized schema for clinical trial enrollment status scoring including status categories (RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED, UNKNOWN) and associated score weights. Define output contract for downstream consumers.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/domain/evaluate_care_quality/clinical_trials_service.py (RECRUITING filter exists; schema extends status handling into scoring contract)

stories.title: Implement enrollment status scoring logic
stories.description: Extend clinical_trials_service to compute a normalized score per trial based on recruitment status, prioritizing RECRUITING trials and downgrading inactive or closed studies. Ensure deterministic mapping from API status field to score.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/domain/evaluate_care_quality/clinical_trials_service.py (existing RECRUITING filter provides source status field and logic foundation)

stories.title: Expose status score via EvaluateCare facade
stories.description: Update evaluate_care_facade to include enrollment status score in clinical trial results payload returned to the chat layer, ensuring compatibility with existing response structures.

stories.title: Add unit tests for status scoring logic
stories.description: Create unit tests validating correct score assignment for each recruitment status category, including edge cases for missing or unknown statuses.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing tests for clinical trial scoring logic; test suite must be extended in backend/tests

stories.title: Add integration test for facade response including status score
stories.description: Validate end-to-end flow from clinical_trials_service through evaluate_care_facade ensuring status score appears correctly in API response payload.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing integration test covers Evaluate Care clinical trial scoring output
